newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Westpac bond priced 18.5 bps over bills.
newsitem.headline: Westpac bond priced 18.5 bps over bills.

text.p: Westpac Banking Corp's A$604.4 million issue of securitised mortgage-backed bonds were priced at a weighted average margin of 18.5 basis point over the one month bank bill rate, Westpac said on Tuesday.
The expected average life of the WST Series 1997-2 bond issue is 3.81 years.
The two tranches of A$604.4 million of floating rate motgage-backed securities consist of A$591.1 million of Class A Notes and A$13.3 million of Class B subordinated debt.
Class A notes were priced at 18 basis points and the Class B at 34 basis points.
"We are very pleased with today's pricing on what we feel is a benchmark issue," said Kimberley Gire, Head of Securitisation at Westpac.
Westpac expects Standard & Poor's to rate the Class A notes at AAA and the Class B at AA minus.
Earlier, Moody's Investors Service rated the Class A notes Aaa.
